title: Actio agent specification (<agent folder>/spec.json)
description: Publication of the agent's identity, capabilities and security features. Capability names must be unique within the agent (not expressible in JSON Schema).

datetime.description: Last time the spec was updated.

namespaces.description: Absent, null or empty: the agent belongs to the null namespace. null can be listed explicitly; "*" means all namespaces.

depends.description: Hard dependencies (agent IDs). Defaults to an empty list.

wants.description: Optional dependencies (agent IDs). Defaults to an empty list.

disabled.description: The agent is disabled (changed with the enable command). Absent means false.

accepts_commands_from.description: Agent IDs allowed to send commands; an empty list means nobody.

capabilities.description: Capabilities offered to the team; can be empty.

security_support.description: Security features implemented; empty if none.

security.description: Security attributes as key-value pairs, e.g. public keys, issuer ID, issuer certificate.

info.description: Extra information; free content, not schema validated.

capability.description: An OpenAI tool definition (name, description, parameters) plus the actio object.

parameters.description: JSON object with the OpenAI tool calling parameter format; can be empty.

accepts_from.description: Absent or empty: every agent can use the capability; otherwise only the listed agents.

max_parallel.description: Maximum parallel requests, managed by the receiver. 0: unbounded.

recommended_timeout.description: Recommended timeout for the response, in seconds.

disabled.description: The capability is disabled or unavailable.
